description.7.0: Free fixed conditions for all nodes in the range.
description.9.0: Free the velocity-fixity conditions for all nodes in the range, thereby allowing these values to change based on the equation of motion. The velocity-fixity conditions are fixed with the structure node fix command.

description.7.0: rotational velocity in all three degrees-of-freedom (node-local system)
description.9.0: rotational velocity in all three rotational degrees-of-freedom (node-local system)

description.7.0: allows automatic updating of the node-local system based on the elements that use the node. This is the default behavior.
description.9.0: allows automatic updating of the node-local system based on the elements that use the node (the node-local system is automatically reoriented from the orientation of the structural elements attached to the node; see the Structural Elements formulation section of the official documentation — the original hyperlink target). This is the default behavior (see structure node fix system-local ).

description.7.0: translational velocity in all three degrees-of-freedom (node local system)
description.9.0: translational velocity in all three translational degrees-of-freedom (node-local system)
